test_title: PYST 195: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 7th Nov, 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Six persons, A, B, C, D, E and F, are sitting in a circle facing towards the centre. B is sitting between A and E. C is sitting between D and F. F is sitting to the immediate left of A. Who is sitting to the immediate right of E?
solution: Given : • Six persons - A, B, C, D, E and F • They are sitting in a circle. • They all are facing towards the center. Explanation : 1)F is sitting to the immediate left of A.
